title: The Madonna Quiz
subtitle: Five rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Rewritten for the Bronze starter set on 20 August 2026 — three rounds now, mixed round types. Read every question in the editor before the gig.

questions.prompt: What is Madonna's real surname, given at birth in 1958?
questions.answerNote: She was born Madonna Louise Ciccone in Bay City, Michigan.

questions.prompt: In which US state was Madonna born?
questions.answerNote: She was born in the town of Bay City, Michigan, in 1958.

questions.prompt: Madonna's hit 'Vogue' featured on the soundtrack of which 1990 film?
questions.answerNote: Madonna starred as Breathless Mahoney in Dick Tracy, which featured 'Vogue'.

questions.prompt: Which 1985 song gave Madonna her first UK number one single?
questions.answerNote: Earlier hits like Holiday and Like a Virgin had stalled just outside the top spot in the UK.

questions.prompt: Madonna won a Golden Globe for playing Eva Perón in which 1996 film?
questions.answerNote: She won Best Actress in a Musical or Comedy at the Golden Globes for Evita.

questions.prompt: 'Frozen' and the title track came from which 1998 Madonna album?
questions.answerNote: Ray of Light won four Grammy Awards in 1999.

questions.prompt: Madonna's 2005 hit 'Hung Up' famously samples a 1979 song by which group?
questions.answerNote: It samples ABBA's 'Gimme! Gimme! Gimme! (A Man After Midnight)'.

questions.prompt: Which record label did Madonna co-found in 1992?
questions.answerNote: Maverick Records was co-founded with manager Freddy DeMann and Guy Oseary.

questions.prompt: In which decade did Madonna release her self-titled debut album?
questions.answerNote: Her debut album, simply titled Madonna, came out in 1983.

questions.prompt: Which world tour, famous for a cone bra by Jean Paul Gaultier, began in 1990?
questions.answerNote: The Blond Ambition Tour's cone bra costume became one of pop's most iconic images.

questions.prompt: Which 1984 album gave Madonna her first US number one album?
questions.answerNote: Nile Rodgers of Chic produced it.

questions.prompt: Which 1986 album contained 'Papa Don't Preach' and 'Open Your Heart'?
questions.answerNote: It was the best-selling album of 1986 worldwide.

questions.prompt: What was the one-word title of Madonna's 1992 book of photographs?
questions.answerNote: It came out in the same week as the album Erotica.

questions.prompt: Which British film director did Madonna marry in 2000?
questions.answerNote: They divorced in 2008.

questions.prompt: Which 2000 album contained the singles 'Music' and 'Don't Tell Me'?
questions.answerNote: Most of it was made with the French producer Mirwais.

questions.prompt: Madonna played a baseball player in which 1992 film?
questions.answerNote: She played 'All the Way' Mae Mordabito alongside Geena Davis and Tom Hanks.

questions.prompt: Which 2019 Madonna album was built around a fictional alter ego?
questions.answerNote: She wrote much of it after moving to Lisbon.

questions.prompt: Madonna recorded the title theme for which 2002 James Bond film?
questions.answerNote: She also appeared in the film itself, as a fencing instructor.

questions.prompt: Which producer worked with Madonna on the album Ray of Light?
questions.answerNote: The record won four Grammy awards.

questions.prompt: Which US city did Madonna move to in 1978 to pursue dancing?
questions.answerNote: She is said to have arrived with about thirty-five dollars.

rounds.title: Round Three — Pick Them All
rounds.blurb: More than one answer is right. Lock in every one of them.

questions.prompt: Which of these are genuine Madonna studio albums?
questions.answerNote: Thriller is Michael Jackson, Purple Rain is Prince, Rumours is Fleetwood Mac.

questions.prompt: Which of these films did Madonna actually appear in?
questions.answerNote: Grease starred Olivia Newton-John; Flashdance starred Jennifer Beals.

questions.prompt: Which of these were genuine Madonna world tours?
questions.answerNote: The Wall Tour was Pink Floyd/Roger Waters; Zoo TV was U2.

questions.prompt: Which of these artists has Madonna actually recorded a duet or featured single with?
questions.answerNote: '4 Minutes' (Timberlake), 'Me Against the Music' (Spears) and 'Bitch I'm Madonna' (Minaj).

questions.prompt: In which of these decades did Madonna have a UK number one single?
questions.answerNote: 80s: Into the Groove. 90s: Vogue, Like a Prayer. 2000s: Music, American Pie, Sorry.

rounds.title: Round Four — First Letter
rounds.blurb: Just the first letter of the answer. Spelling does not count.

questions.prompt: What one-word title took Madonna to UK number one in November 1990, also the name of a dance style she helped popularise?
questions.answerNote: Vogue spent four weeks at UK number one.

questions.prompt: Which record label did Madonna co-found with her manager in 1992, later also home to Alanis Morissette?
questions.answerNote: Maverick was co-founded with Freddy DeMann and Guy Oseary.

questions.prompt: In which US city did Madonna headline the Super Bowl halftime show in February 2012?
questions.answerNote: Super Bowl XLVI was played at Lucas Oil Stadium.

questions.prompt: Which US chat-show host confiscated a knife from Madonna live on air in a notorious 1994 interview?
questions.answerNote: The Late Show appearance is still one of the most cited awkward interviews in TV history.

questions.prompt: What is the title of Madonna's controversial 1989 song and video, featuring burning crosses, that cost her a Pepsi sponsorship deal?
questions.answerNote: Pepsi pulled the ad campaign within days of the video's release.
